messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "title": "Repeated Save Actions Fail",
 "problem_statement": "Users must click Save multiple times across claims and reports, but the action often fails, forcing repetitive efforts. This wastes time and causes frustration because progress is lost or delayed.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "quote": "Claims: click \"Open\"...Claims: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-20T13:34:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-22T09:41:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Claim details: click \"Next\"...click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-25T12:46:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Administration: click \"Permission\", rage x5\nClaims: click \"Save\"",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-09T08:26:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-13T13:48:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Claims: click \"Details\" ... Claims: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-09-24T16:36:00Z"
  },
  {
   "quote": "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3",
   "route": "sessions",
   "date": "2026-10-29T10:23:00Z"
  }
 ]
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that Save actions repeatedly fail across Claims and Reports, forcing multiple clicks and rage signals. All seven session quotes show users clicking Save (and related actions like Open, Next, Details, Permission) followed by rage clicks, consistently across September and October 2026 and across multiple product areas. This is a recurring in-product behavior problem a squad could investigate and fix, not a pricing, contract, or customer-IT issue, and no help article would resolve a failing save action.", "verdict": "pass"}
